author: Logan Fuller
name: Decent Sync
description: Streams shots, beans, batches, grinders, profiles, settings and machine activity to a central Decent Sync server.

ServerUrl.label: Sync server URL
ServerUrl.description: WebSocket URL of the Decent Sync server (ws:// on the LAN, wss:// over the internet).

MachineName.label: Machine name
MachineName.description: Friendly name for this machine on the sync server, e.g. "Home DE1Pro".

AuthToken.label: Auth token
AuthToken.description: Shared secret the server expects. Leave empty if the server runs without a token.

PollSeconds.label: Change poll interval (seconds)
PollSeconds.description: How often to check beans, batches, grinders, profiles and settings for changes.
